acceptance_reason: Occupants retain stable identity and coherent vessel-local/world positions; vessel motion is applied exactly once; transitions on/off vessel are explicit and reversible.

definition.fail_criteria: Occupants drift/teleport/double-move, authoritative location becomes ambiguous, or boarding changes semantic identity.
definition.inconclusive_conditions: Test uses only visual parenting with no authoritative interaction/physics consequence.
invalidation_conditions: Evidence is unusable due to wrong build/configuration, measurement defect or contamination.
A proof run without adequate exact build identity may be INVALIDATED.
definition.pass_criteria: Occupants retain stable identity and coherent vessel-local/world positions; vessel motion is applied exactly once; transitions on/off vessel are explicit and reversible.
procedure: Move multiple stable occupants/cargo/transient objects relative to a moving vessel.
Exercise board/disembark and vessel-world frame conversion under translation and rotation.
Delay one transform projection and cross a region while occupied.
definition.question: Can occupants, cargo and transient objects remain semantically and spatially coherent on a translating/rotating vessel without double-applying motion or losing world/vessel frame identity?
definition.required_repetition: At least 10,000 movement steps across motion profiles and hundreds of board/disembark transitions.
definition.title: Moving Vessel Occupants

observations: Occupant semantic identity and vessel-local position remained stable across explicit frame projection.
